nodes.name: switch.css
nodes.summary: Styles the Switch toggle component via nested [data-component="switch"] attribute selectors covering the hidden input, thumb, and label slots.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the project convention of styling SolidJS components through [data-component]/[data-slot] attribute selectors with native CSS nesting instead of class names.

nodes.name: tabs.css
nodes.summary: Comprehensive stylesheet for the Tabs component defining bar-height custom properties, compact pill variants, mono/color file-icon states, and a 640px responsive breakpoint.
nodes.languageNotes: Drives layout metrics from --tabs-* custom properties so variants (compact pills) can be tuned without new selectors; a min-width 640px media query switches the desktop layout.

nodes.name: tag.css
nodes.summary: Minimal styling for the Tag badge component: an inline-flex pill with a weak border, raised surface background, and radius tokens.

nodes.name: text-field.css
nodes.summary: Styles the text input component ([data-component="input"]) with typography and color tokens applied to the nested input slot.

nodes.name: text-reveal.css
nodes.summary: Implements the TextReveal mask-position wipe animation, sweeping the mask itself across each span (top-to-bottom) so new text drops in and old text exits downward, with a prefers-reduced-motion fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Animates mask-position rather than transforming the text, an odometer alternative documented in the file's header comment.

nodes.name: text-shimmer.css
nodes.summary: Custom-property-driven shimmer animation for the TextShimmer component with a text-shimmer-sweep keyframe, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.
nodes.languageNotes: All timing (step/duration/swap) and geometry (angle/spread/size) live in --text-shimmer-* custom properties, letting the TSX component stagger items per index without extra keyframes.

nodes.name: text-strikethrough.css
nodes.summary: Spring-animated strikethrough that draws a line left-to-right via clip-path on a transparent-text overlay layered with grid stacking, with a reduced-motion fallback.
nodes.languageNotes: Hides glyph paint with -webkit-text-fill-color on a grid-area: 1/1 overlay so the decoration animates independently of the base text.

nodes.name: toast.css
nodes.summary: Styles the fixed-position toast notification region with toastPopIn, toastPopOut, and toastSwipeOut keyframe animations.
nodes.languageNotes: Separate enter/exit/swipe keyframes let the TSX toast component choreograph dismissal gestures (swipe-out) distinctly from timed auto-dismiss.

nodes.name: tool-count-label.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool count label as a nowrap inline-flex with before/count/after slots baseline-aligned, plus a reduced-motion fallback.

nodes.name: tool-count-summary.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool count summary row with an empty-state grid slot that cross-fades rows on a shared baseline, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a single-column inline-grid so the empty state and content can transition through the same grid cell.

nodes.name: tool-error-card.css
nodes.summary: Theme override sheet that retunes the generic Card and Collapsible components for tool error display via [data-kind="tool-error-card"], adjusting padding and open-state gaps.
nodes.languageNotes: Composes with the shared Card by overriding --card-* custom properties and child selectors rather than duplicating card styles.

nodes.name: tool-status-title.css
nodes.summary: Styles the tool status title with baseline-aligned suffix and duration slots, honoring prefers-reduced-motion.

nodes.name: tooltip.css
nodes.summary: Simple flex layout styling for the tooltip trigger and the tooltip keybind hint slot.

nodes.name: typewriter.css
nodes.summary: 14-line sheet defining the blinking-cursor blink keyframe (opacity stepped at 50%) for the Typewriter component.
